# wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc (Data Source)

Get information about an OIDC authentication domain configured on the WALLIX Bastion (API v3.12
or later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc" "corporate" {
  domain_name = "corporate.oidc"
}

resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "admins" {
  domain_id      = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc.corporate.id
  user_group     = "admins"
  external_group = "bastion-admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `label` (String)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String)

## Usage Notes

`domain_name` looks up the domain; the data source fails when no OIDC authentication domain has
this name.
